findings.title: Health gate can accept a stale successful result
findings.description: `run_health` ignores the return code from the health command and accepts the last `FLAGS` line in the log without verifying that this invocation wrote it. If the command fails before appending to the log, an earlier healthy result can satisfy the gate and allow later cutover steps to proceed. Check the command result and ensure the parsed log entry is fresh before treating the health check as successful.

findings.title: Unexpected step errors bypass the cutover report
findings.description: `run_steps` catches only `StepFailed` and `CalledProcessError`. Other operational errors—such as `FileNotFoundError` from a missing command or `OSError` from a log read—escape the loop, so `main` never writes the report despite the script’s stated guarantee that failures are recorded. Convert expected host-operation errors into a recorded step failure, or ensure report writing occurs even when an unexpected step error escapes.
